title: Neutral hook manifest
description: Lifecycle hooks written once and generated into the Claude, Cursor, Codex and Copilot dialects. Authored as hooks.source.json: the path hooks/hooks.json is auto-discovered by three clients in three incompatible dialects, so it is generated, never written by hand.

description.description: Why this plugin declares hooks at all.

hooks.description: One entry per neutral event. Only events every client can express are allowed.

unmatchedHooks.description: Hooks on an event with nothing to match against. A matcher here would be dropped by every client, so it is rejected.

script.description: Basename of a script pair in scripts/. Both <name>.sh and <name>.ps1 must exist, because one generated hooks file is shared by macOS and Windows. Never a path or a command line: the generator owns the invocation.

matcher.description: Regular expression narrowing when the hook fires. Applied by the client where its own matcher filters the same subject, and passed to the script otherwise, so one regex decides the outcome on every client. Must not contain " \ $ or `, which a POSIX shell and PowerShell quote differently.

timeout.description: Seconds before the client abandons the hook.
